name: sloppy-monorepo
description: Sloppy: The ultimate AI slop UI fixer combining Stageshow's craft principles, React kit, 74 pattern directories, MCP server, and universal agent skill.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@sloppy/core && npm run build --workspace=@sloppy/mcp && npm run build --workspace=sloppy && npm run build --workspace=@sloppy/playground
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=@sloppy/core && npm run typecheck --workspace=@sloppy/mcp && npm run typecheck --workspace=sloppy && npm run typecheck --workspace=@sloppy/kit && npm run typecheck --workspace=@sloppy/verify && npm run typecheck --workspace=@sloppy/playground
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace=@sloppy/core && npm run test:rubric && npm run test:unit
scripts.verify:all: npm run typecheck && npm run test
